extension.description: A community-developed unofficial VS Code extension for working with WCH projects from MounRiver Studio.
viewContainer.title: WCH VS Code Extension
configuration.title: wch-vscode
configuration.mounRiverStudioPath.descri: MounRiver Studio installation root, for example F:\MounRiver\MounRiver_Studio2. When generating C/C++ configuration, the extension automatically resolves resources\app\resources\win32\components\WCH\Toolchain\RISC-V Embedded GCC\bin\riscv-none-embed-gcc.exe.
configuration.buildMethod.description: Select how WCH projects are built: the extension parses the project parameters and calls make, or MRS parses the parameters and builds.
configuration.buildMethod.make.label: Plugin parses parameters
configuration.buildMethod.mrsCli.label: MRS parses parameters
configuration.buildMethod.make: Plugin parses parameters: the extension parses the project configuration, generates makefiles, and calls make directly.
configuration.buildMethod.mrsCli: MRS parses parameters: MRS parses the project configuration and builds itself, identical to building inside MRS.
